title: 4-to-2 Priority Encoder
statement: Implement a 4-to-2 priority encoder that outputs the binary index of the highest-priority set input. If no input is asserted, valid should be low and code should be zero. Priority is assigned from input 3 down to input 0.
module_signature: module priority_encoder_4to2(input [3:0] in, output reg [1:0] code, output reg valid);
behavior: code reports the highest asserted bit position when any input is set.
valid is 1 when any bit is asserted, else 0.
The module must be purely combinational.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use registers beyond combinational output assignments.
hint: Evaluate inputs from highest to lowest priority.
